title: Médico Endocrinologista (RQE)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Endocrinologista (RQE) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Website Designer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Website Designer


Remote | Contract


About BX Studio


BX Studio is a digital agency specializing in website design, development, and optimization. We partner with clients in diverse sectors to create high-performing, visually compelling websites that drive results. Our service model is tuned for rapid delivery, building on Webflow, Framer and AI stacks. Our team is committed to delivering exceptional quality and maintaining long-term client relationships through ongoing strategic, creative and technical support. We pride ourselves on our collaborative culture, technical expertise, and dedication to staying at the forefront of web development best practices. BX Studio was recognized as Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year 2025.


Job description

As a Web Designer at BX Studio, you will play a crucial role in leading the design and development of visually compelling and user-friendly websites for our clients. You will work closely with our clients, project managers, and development team to conceptualize, design, and implement custom web solutions that meet our clients' objectives and exceed their expectations. This role requires comfort using AI-assisted design workflows to support faster ideation, stronger creative exploration, improved UX thinking, and efficient delivery across modern website projects.


Key Responsibilities


● Lead the design process from concept to completion, ensuring all deliverables meet  high-quality standards and align with client goals.


● Collaborate with clients to understand their brand identity, target audience, and business objectives in order to create customized website designs that resonate with their audience.


● Develop wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to effectively communicate design concepts and user interactions to support rapid exploration and iteration.


● Create visually appealing graphics, icons, and other assets to enhance the overall aesthetic and user experience of websites, to meet BX Studio’s standards for originality, quality, and brand fit.


● Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, emerging technologies, and AI-assisted design workflows to continually improve the quality and innovation of our web designs.


● Mentor and provide guidance to junior designers, fostering their growth and development within the team.

● Work closely with the development team to ensure seamless integration of design elements and functionality.


● Conduct usability testing and gather feedback to iterate and refine designs for optimal user experience to identify patterns, summarize feedback, and support design improvements.


● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure project timelines and milestones are met effectively to improve speed, quality, and delivery efficiency.


Qualifications:


● Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Web Design, or a related field.


● Minimum of 5 years of experience in web design, with a strong portfolio showcasing a range of successful projects.


● Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, XD), Sketch, or Figma, with practical experience using AI-assisted design tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Figma AI, Relume, Framer AI, or similar tools.


● Solid understanding of responsive design principles and best practices for web usability and accessibility, content hierarchy, and UX improvements.


● Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/jQuery, with the ability to collaborate effectively with developers on both traditional and AI-enabled website experiences.


● Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present and explain design concepts to clients and team members.


● Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines to improve efficiency without compromising quality.


● Experience with content management systems (CMS) such as Webflow, with familiarity in Webflow, and Framer is considered a strong plus.


● A passion for creativity, innovation, and staying abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and responsible AI use in modern web design.


Join our dynamic team and help us create exceptional web experiences that drive success for our clients! If you're passionate about design, technology, AI-assisted workflows, and making a real impact, we want to hear from you.

title: Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make an incredible impact in the world of socially conscious brands?


Lucyd Media is a social advertising agency, specializing in the compliant advertising for CBD, Cannabis, and other DTC wellness e-commerce brands. Our mission is to reduce human suffering and maximize human potential by facilitating the distribution of Conscious Compounds™


We are currently seeking a strong landing page (LP) designer to lead the design and optimization of the post-click experience across our paid media funnels.


At Lucyd, we believe the post-click experience is one of the biggest underutilized levers in wellness growth. We need someone who can bring real authority to that part of the funnel, move quickly, use AI aggressively, and help us create a more seamless conversion experience across the brands we serve. This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy.


Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you.


What You Will Be Responsible For:

  • Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages
  • Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences
  • Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience
  • Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance
  • Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion
  • Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd
  • Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage
  • Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams


What We Are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design.
  • A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed. Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.
  • Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad.
  • Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships.
  • Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plus


Success Roadmap:


In 30 Days, You'll:

  • Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages.
  • Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences.
  • Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed.
  • Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts.

In 60 Days, You'll:

  • Partner closely with Growth Strategists to align page structure with ad hooks, offers, and buyer intent.
  • Start identifying patterns in what is driving or hurting conversion across pages.
  • Own the design and optimization of post-click experiences for multiple active accounts.
  • Contribute to a faster, more repeatable landing page production process

In 90 Days, You'll:

  • Be the clear internal owner of conversion-focused post-click design
  • Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages.
  • Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage.
  • Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad.


By Your One-Year Anniversary:

You will have helped establish Lucyd’s post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to:

  • Faster landing page creation and iteration
  • Higher-quality post-click experiences
  • Better alignment between ads, offers, and page structure
  • A more intentional system for designing and optimizing pages users land on after the click


Apply now to become an integral part of our mission to connect socially conscious brands with their audiences in meaningful ways.

description:

About the Company

Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.


About the Role

The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. title: Implementation Analyst (WFH)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Implementation Analyst (WFH) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Implementation Analyst


Resume:

English version only

Highlight - Implementations, Client Onboarding, SAAS

Role Type: Full-Time Contractor

Hours: Must be willing to work US Hours

Location: Brazil

Rate: R$ 8,000 - 10,000 monthly


About The Methodical Group

The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.


About the Opportunity:

We are seeking an Implementation Analyst to support our client's Professional Services team. The Implementation Analyst is responsible for leading end-to-end deployments of our SaaS applications across all areas of municipal government. Guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful adoption. Acting as both a project lead and product expert, you'll collaborate closely with clients to understand their business requirements and translate them into effective, scalable system solutions. You will play a key role in ensuring each customer realizes measurable value from our platform while providing a seamless, high-quality onboarding experience.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients
  • Conduct discovery sessions with clients to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics
  • Configure and customize the SaaS platform to meet client-specific use cases while adhering to best practices
  • Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and system integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live
  • Provide customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments
  • Monitor project health and timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, and dependencies
  • Document configuration details, process decisions, and knowledge articles to maintain implementation consistency and scalability
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Support, and Customer Success to ensure seamless transitions post-launch
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement, recommending best practices to optimize future deployments


Required & Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of Professional Services Implementation experience with Enterprise SaaS products required
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles required
  • Baseline familiarity with data concepts including file formats, field mapping, and data validation sufficient to coordinate effectively with Data Engineers required
  • Proficiency with tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or other implementation-related platforms required
  • Experience working directly with clients and managing concurrent implementation projects required
  • Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships professionally and set clear expectations throughout a project lifecycle required
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear business explanations required
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills required
  • Excellent organizational, time-management, and prioritization skills required
  • Ability to learn new technologies and concepts quickly required

description:

Lasso MD is a service-based platform designed to simplify and enhance patient growth for healthcare practices. title: Principal SQL Server Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Principal SQL Server Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $5,500 - $7,000 USD


Along with our partner, we’re looking for a Principal Database Engineer who can serve as the technical leader for our SQL Server–focused engineering team. This person should be the team’s strongest expert in SQL Server development, performance engineering, and operational reliability — and equally strong in designing

data‐centric solutions that balance correctness, performance, maintainability, and business constraints.


The ideal candidate brings deep, hands‐on mastery of SQL Server internals and can connect engine

behavior to real‐world workload patterns. They should be able to diagnose, design, enhance, and

optimize database solutions at scale, and guide others in doing the same.


You will collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to ensure requirements are

well‐understood, technically feasible, and aligned with long‐term architectural goals.


Essential Duties:

  • Database Design and Development: Guide the evolution and improvement of database architecture, design and implementations. Apply expert‐level understanding of relational modeling, T‐SQL, indexing strategies, and SQL Server engine behavior to build systems that scale and perform under real‐world workloads.
  • Performance Monitoring and Optimization: Continuously assess system performance at both the instance and query level. Diagnose and remediate issues, including those involving poor execution plans, parameter sniffing, bad cardinality estimation, SARGability obstacles, inadequate or incorrect indexing, and concurrency issues involving locking, blocking, and/or deadlocks.
  • Engineering Solution Design: Break down complex data and workload problems, identify multiple viable solution paths, and evaluate them against functional and non‐functional requirements. Clearly articulate tradeoffs, recommend, and justify the best approach.
  • Collaboration with Development Teams: Partner closely with application and service teams to ensure database designs support application behavior, performance goals, and operational constraints. Provide guidance on query patterns, schema usage, and integration with .NET and cloud services.
  • Incident Management: Lead the response to database‐related incidents. Perform root‐cause analysis, implement durable fixes, and improve observability, alerting, and operational readiness.
  • Mentorship and Training: Coach and mentor database engineers and developers. Establish and promote best practices in SQL development, performance tuning, and operational excellence.
  • Data Security Management: Contribute to the implementation and enforcement of security controls, ensuring protection of sensitive data and compliance with relevant standards.
  • Backup, Recovery, and Reliability Engineering: Contribute to the design and management of resilient backup, restore, and disaster‐recovery processes. Help ensure systems are prepared for failure scenarios and can recover predictably.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • Experience: 10+ years in database engineering, data management, or database administration, with significant hands‐on experience in SQL Server.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Deep expertise in SQL Server development, performance tuning, and engine internals.
  • Strong understanding of indexing, execution plans, statistics, concurrency, and workload behavior.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), including managed SQL services and related data technologies.
  • Proficiency in T‐SQL; familiarity with C#/.NET services is a plus.


Key Competencies:

  • Database Design and Architecture: Ability to design scalable, efficient SQL Server solutions in cloud environments, with strong judgment around schema design, indexing, and workload patterns.
  • Performance Tuning and Optimization: Expertise in diagnosing and resolving performance issues at all layers of the SQL Server stack.
  • Cloud Technologies: Experience with cloud‐based database services (Azure SQL, Managed Instance, AWS RDS, etc.) and understanding of how cloud infrastructure impacts database design and performance.
  • Programming and Engineering Skills: Strong T‐SQL development skills and familiarity with the broader SQL Server ecosystem. Ability to reason about system‐level design and integrate database solutions with application architectures.
  • Data Management and Security: Ensure data integrity, enforce security controls, and resolve data‐related issues with precision and accountability.
  • Leadership and Collaboration: Provide technical leadership, mentor team members, and communicate clearly with cross‐functional partners. Influence architectural direction and foster a culture of engineering excellence.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to lead and optimize large-scale data systems that power critical business operations.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

English version only

About The Methodical Group

The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.

We are seeking an Implementation Analyst to support our client's Professional Services team. The Implementation Analyst is responsible for leading end-to-end deployments of our SaaS applications across all areas of municipal government. Guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful adoption. You will play a key role in ensuring each customer realizes measurable value from our platform while providing a seamless, high-quality onboarding experience.

  • Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients

  • Monitor project health and timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, and dependencies
  • Document configuration details, process decisions, and knowledge articles to maintain implementation consistency and scalability
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Support, and Customer Success to ensure seamless transitions post-launch
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement, recommending best practices to optimize future deployments


Required & Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of Professional Services Implementation experience with Enterprise SaaS products required
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles required
  • Baseline familiarity with data concepts including file formats, field mapping, and data validation sufficient to coordinate effectively with Data Engineers required
  • Proficiency with tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or other implementation-related platforms required
  • Experience working directly with clients and managing concurrent implementation projects required
  • Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships professionally and set clear expectations throughout a project lifecycle required
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear business explanations required
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills required
  • Excellent organizational, time-management, and prioritization skills required
  • Ability to learn new technologies and concepts quickly required

title: Associate Account Executive - Biopharma
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Associate Account Executive - Biopharma em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you.


Responsibilities:


  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts.
  • Conduct active outreach to build and progress opportunities in the pipeline to meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Build and execute a persistent outbound sales strategy, including cold calls and emails, to generate interest and accelerate new business generation.
  • Establish and maintain strong and professional relationships with biopharma librarians, R&D leadership and stakeholders.
  • Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account.


Requirements:


  • A bachelor's degree
  • 2+ years of direct selling experience to stakeholders in the pharmaceutical, biotech, device, or healthcare industry.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales objectives.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and manage a full sales cycle.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • A disciplined approach to daily activity planning, setting goals, and achieving success.
  • Experience with Salesforce or relevant sales CRM, MS Office is required.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package, including unlimited commissions.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and productivity.
  • Opportunity to work in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: BI Operations Specialist
description:

We are looking for a remote, full-time BI Operations Specialist with 2 to 4 years of experience to manage the daily health and evolution of the data visualization layer. In this role, while the Lead Analytics Engineer will handle high-level architecture and new project intake, you will be the primary point of contact for end-users. Your mission is to ensure that once a tool is launched, it remains accurate, useful, and high-performing. You will handle the \"last mile\" of data-managing user feedback, making tactical adjustments to dashboards, and ensuring the business is getting maximum value from our existing tools. You will work directly under the Lead Analytics Engineer, and you will be the \"boots on the ground\" for the Domo environment.

Our US-based client is a trusted national provider of end-to-end outsourced yard logistics. They specialize in sustainable, optimized enterprise yard and transportation services and solutions for all-sized yards across retail, manufacturing, and distribution sectors. They offer decades of proven expertise from working with large shippers, leading Silicon Valley companies, and top-tier consulting firms to provide reliable, high-performance services, all while lowering the total cost of your operations.

Their deep understanding of the operational challenges from multiple perspectives and their commitment to operational excellence, sustainability, and implementing cutting-edge technology make our client the go-to partner for enterprises seeking world-class yard logistics solutions.


Responsibilities

  • User Success & Support: Act as the first point of contact for end-user inquiries, troubleshooting visualization issues, and clarifying data definitions for the team
  • Dashboard Maintenance: Perform ongoing adjustments, cosmetic improvements, and layout updates to existing Domo dashboards and apps based on user feedback
  • Usage Monitoring: Proactively track user adoption and engagement metrics within Domo to identify which tools are providing value and which need refinement
  • Data Validation (Front-End): Write SQL in Snowflake to verify that the numbers appearing in Domo match the source data, ensuring a high level of data trust across the company
  • Incremental Enhancements: Translate small-scale user requests (new filters, additional charts, modified logic) into reality without needing constant architectural oversight
  • Documentation: Keep user-facing documentation and data dictionaries up to date as dashboards evolve


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2 to 4 years of experience in a BI-focused role
  • Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Domo, etc
  • Experience working with AWS
  • Proficiency in writing SQL queries to explore and validate data within Snowflake
  • Ability to pivot between multiple small tasks, moving from a bug fix to a layout adjustment to a user training session seamlessly
  • Clear and empathetic communication style for helping users navigate data tools


Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with Jira, GitHub, and Confluence
  • Familiarity with the yard management industry
  • Awareness of logistics and supply chain management


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Website Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Website Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Website Designer


Remote | Contract


About BX Studio


BX Studio is a digital agency specializing in website design, development, and optimization. We partner with clients in diverse sectors to create high-performing, visually compelling websites that drive results. Our service model is tuned for rapid delivery, building on Webflow, Framer and AI stacks. Our team is committed to delivering exceptional quality and maintaining long-term client relationships through ongoing strategic, creative and technical support. We pride ourselves on our collaborative culture, technical expertise, and dedication to staying at the forefront of web development best practices. BX Studio was recognized as Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year 2025.


Job description

As a Web Designer at BX Studio, you will play a crucial role in leading the design and development of visually compelling and user-friendly websites for our clients. You will work closely with our clients, project managers, and development team to conceptualize, design, and implement custom web solutions that meet our clients' objectives and exceed their expectations. This role requires comfort using AI-assisted design workflows to support faster ideation, stronger creative exploration, improved UX thinking, and efficient delivery across modern website projects.


Key Responsibilities


● Lead the design process from concept to completion, ensuring all deliverables meet  high-quality standards and align with client goals.


● Collaborate with clients to understand their brand identity, target audience, and business objectives in order to create customized website designs that resonate with their audience.


● Develop wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to effectively communicate design concepts and user interactions to support rapid exploration and iteration.


● Create visually appealing graphics, icons, and other assets to enhance the overall aesthetic and user experience of websites, to meet BX Studio’s standards for originality, quality, and brand fit.


● Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, emerging technologies, and AI-assisted design workflows to continually improve the quality and innovation of our web designs.


● Mentor and provide guidance to junior designers, fostering their growth and development within the team.

● Work closely with the development team to ensure seamless integration of design elements and functionality.


● Conduct usability testing and gather feedback to iterate and refine designs for optimal user experience to identify patterns, summarize feedback, and support design improvements.


● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure project timelines and milestones are met effectively to improve speed, quality, and delivery efficiency.


Qualifications:


● Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Web Design, or a related field.


● Minimum of 5 years of experience in web design, with a strong portfolio showcasing a range of successful projects.


● Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, XD), Sketch, or Figma, with practical experience using AI-assisted design tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Figma AI, Relume, Framer AI, or similar tools.


● Solid understanding of responsive design principles and best practices for web usability and accessibility, content hierarchy, and UX improvements.


● Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/jQuery, with the ability to collaborate effectively with developers on both traditional and AI-enabled website experiences.


● Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present and explain design concepts to clients and team members.


● Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines to improve efficiency without compromising quality.


● Experience with content management systems (CMS) such as Webflow, with familiarity in Webflow, and Framer is considered a strong plus.


● A passion for creativity, innovation, and staying abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and responsible AI use in modern web design.


Join our dynamic team and help us create exceptional web experiences that drive success for our clients! If you're passionate about design, technology, AI-assisted workflows, and making a real impact, we want to hear from you.

title: Engenheiro de Confiabilidade de Sites (SRE)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de Confiabilidade de Sites (SRE) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento varejista de materiais de construção e melhoria residencial..


Key Responsibilities

  • Buscamos um(a) Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) com forte atuação em ambientes Kubernetes
  • Responsável por garantir a estabilidade, confiabilidade e observabilidade dos sistemas
  • Atuação hands-on em troubleshooting e resolução de problemas
  • Realização de ajustes em infraestrutura
  • Suporte a aplicações, incluindo:
  • Leitura de código em Go
  • Realização de pequenos patches


Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • Experiência prática como SRE, DevOps ou função similar
  • Domínio de Kubernetes (deployments, debugging e operação)
  • Experiência com:
  • Helm
  • Kustomize
  • Conhecimento em Envoy (troubleshooting e debugging)
  • Capacidade de ler e fazer pequenos patches em código Go
  • Experiência com Grafana (criação e manutenção de dashboards)
  • Boa capacidade de troubleshooting em ambientes distribuídos
  • Experiência com:
  • GitHub Actions (mesmo que apenas rodando/manipando pipelines)
  • Spinnaker


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.


Tempo de Projeto:

Tempo indeterminado.

title: Analista de DataOps - Tableau (PJ)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de DataOps - Tableau (PJ) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A BDA Solutions, consultoria especializada em Data & AI, está selecionando um(a) Analista de Dados com especialização em DataOps e gestão da plataforma Tableau para atuar em projeto estratégico com um de nossos clientes — grande empresa do setor de tecnologia.

O profissional irá assumir a gestão e sustentação completa do ambiente Tableau , com foco imediato em um projeto crítico de governança de licenças, evoluindo para a implantação de um framework robusto de qualidade e governança de dados.

Modalidade: PJ · Remoto · Tempo integral · Início imediato - TABLEAU


Desafio:

Conduzir o mapeamento e regularização de um grande volume de licenças compartilhadas, com migração de centenas de usuários para contas nominais. Executar queries SQL no banco de dados do Tableau para extrair um raio-x completo do ambiente, incluindo objetos, conexões, data sources, grupos, permissões e atividade por licença. Estruturar e executar o plano de operacionalização: criação de contas, revisão de permissões, comunicação com usuários e desligamento das licenças compartilhadas. Documentar todo o processo e fluxos para construção da base de governança.


Sustentação e Operação Diária:

Monitorar jobs, agendamentos e cargas de dados, verificando a integridade das conexões entre sistemas como ERP, Data Warehouse e BI. Assegurar a execução correta dos processos ETL/ELT e a disponibilidade do ambiente Tableau. Atender chamados técnicos de concessão de acesso e troubleshooting, apoiando analistas de negócio na resolução de divergências. Administrar permissões no Tableau Server e/ou Cloud conforme políticas internas de segurança e compliance.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

Experiência sólida com:

  • Tableau Server e/ou Tableau Cloud.
  • Domínio de SQL, incluindo queries analíticas em bancos de metadados e repositórios internos.
  • Conhecimento em processos ETL/ELT e governança de dados.
  • Familiaridade com integrações entre sistemas corporativos como ERP, CRM e Data Warehouse.
  • Perfil autônomo e investigativo: sabe identificar e resolver problemas sem precisar de acompanhamento constante. Comunicação clara e capacidade de documentação técnica.
  • Uso de ferramentas de IA como Claude ou ChatGPT para acelerar análises e construção de queries.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com gestão de licenças e estrutura de permissões no Tableau.
  • Conhecimento em Python para automação de tarefas.
  • Experiência com ambientes de nuvem como AWS ou Azure.


Se você é o tipo de profissional que toma frente do ambiente, resolve sem esperar ser chamado e usa IA para entregar mais rápido — queremos te conhecer.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Project Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position, PJ contract and salary range is 28-35/hr USD.


Required Skills & Experience


• 5+ years in Technical Program Management, Program Management, or Delivery/Project Leadership in software/product environments.

• Strong experience working with engineering teams (front-end, back-end, APIs, integrations) and translating requirements into execution plans.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple parallel workstreams with dependencies, ambiguity, and shifting priorities.

• Comfort operating in Agile delivery environments and facilitating common delivery ceremonies.

• Strong ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders—written, verbal, and executive-ready status reporting.

• Proven organizational skills: structured thinking, attention to detail, follow-through, and accountability.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• CPG experience (Consumer Packaged Goods) or work supporting enterprise-scale commerce, marketing, or customer platforms.

• Experience using GitHub for product/engineering workflows (issues, epics, project boards, milestones, release tracking).

• AI workflow experience (automation, copilots/assistants, orchestration tools, or applied AI to improve delivery ops).

• Experience supporting digital commerce capabilities (e.g., customer experience, product catalogs, order flows, promotions, personalization, content, analytics).

• Familiarity with Elixir and/or React environments—enough to partner effectively with engineers, understand constraints, and anticipate delivery risks.


Job Description


The Digital Commerce team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to amplify product delivery and relieve a Product Manager who is currently balancing product discovery alongside multiple concurrent projects. This TPM will drive program execution across cross-functional teams—translating product intent into clear plans, predictable delivery, and measurable outcomes—while ensuring work is well-managed in GitHub (where our PM workflows now live). This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and operations—bringing structure, visibility, and momentum to complex initiatives, and enabling the PM to focus on customer and market discovery.

• Own end-to-end program management for multiple digital commerce initiatives, from intake through delivery and rollout.

• Build and maintain integrated plans (milestones, dependencies, risks, resourcing, timeline) across product, engineering, data, QA, security, and partner teams.

• Drive delivery rituals: standups, sprint/iteration planning support, backlog readiness, dependency reviews, status reporting, and go/no-go readiness.

• Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders—ensuring alignment on scope, sequencing, tradeoffs, and “definition of done.”

• Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and decisions; escalate with context and options, not just problems.

• Ensure clear communication across teams and leadership with concise updates and action-oriented readouts.

• Help standardize how initiatives are tracked in GitHub (e.g., issues, epics, project boards, milestones), driving consistent hygiene and visibility.

• Improve team throughput by reducing friction in processes and tooling (templates, workflows, reporting, intake). • Identify opportunities to use AI-enabled workflows to reduce overhead (e.g., release comms drafting, backlog grooming support, automated status summaries, incident triage workflows, documentation acceleration) while maintaining governance and quality.

• Partner with engineering and product to implement pragmatic automation that improves delivery efficiency.

• Coordinate release plans across teams: readiness checklists, rollout sequencing, communication plans, training/support readiness, and post-launch monitoring.

• Ensure operational handoffs and documentation are complete for production support.

title: Sr. TypeScript Developer
description:

Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Sr. TypeScript Developer to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Brazil or North America

Industry: IT & Services

You are deeply experienced in AI‑driven and agentic development workflows, using tools such as Claude and/or Cursor to significantly increase development speed, quality, and iteration velocity. You are comfortable with vibe coding, working fluidly with AI to explore solutions, refine implementations, and ship results quickly. You thrive in sprint‑based teams with clear deadlines, take ownership of complex workstreams, and consistently perform at a high output level. You are comfortable collaborating with distributed teams and ramping quickly on new codebases, tooling, and workflows.


Sr. TypeScript Engineer | Day-to-Day

  • Build, refactor, and deliver production‑ready features using TypeScript in a modern application stack.
  • Leverage advanced AI coding tools (Claude and/or Cursor) as a core part of your daily development workflow, including agentic and iterative coding patterns.
  • Apply agentic development workflows to break down problems, generate solutions, validate approaches, and accelerate delivery.
  • Work within sprint cycles, committing to scoped deliverables and consistently meeting assigned deadlines.
  • Deliver a high volume of story points per sprint, aligning with top‑tier performance benchmarks.
  • Collaborate closely with senior engineers and technical leadership to solve complex technical problems.
  • Review and improve existing code while maintaining performance, readability, and scalability.
  • Participate in technical discussions and help shape best practices for AI‑assisted and agentic development.


Sr. TypeScript Engineer | Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in software development, engineering, or a closely related role, delivering production‑ready applications in fast‑paced environments.
  • Strong, hands‑on fluency with TypeScript, including building and maintaining scalable, maintainable code within modern application architectures.
  • Demonstrated experience with agentic development workflows, using AI to plan, iterate, validate solutions, and accelerate engineering tasks from end‑to‑end.
  • Recent, dedicated experience using Claude and/or Cursor at an advanced level, leveraging these tools for high‑velocity, high‑quality development beyond basic code generation.
  • Comfortable with vibe coding, working interactively with AI to explore approaches, refine implementations, and quickly converge on production‑ready outcomes.
  • Proven ability to deliver high output in sprint‑based development environments, consistently meeting or exceeding expectations for scoped work and story point delivery.
  • Fluent or very strong English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed, cross‑functional teams.

title: Executive Assistant
description:

We're Hiring: Executive Assistant — Home Services (Remote, Brazil)

We're hiring an Executive Assistant to be the right hand of a business owner running a fast-growing home services operation in the U.S. market. You'll work directly with the owner — closing deals, running daily operations, and keeping the business moving. If you've sold before and have the numbers to prove it, keep reading.


Compensation — $1,000 to $1,800/month (USD)


Your base is $1,000/month. Your performance moves it up — permanently.

  • $1,000/month base (USD)
  • +$250 permanent raise after closing $5K in revenue
  • +$150 permanent raise after closing $10K in revenue
  • + performance incentives based on deals closed, profit margins, and reviews generated


Hit your numbers and you ramp from $1,000 to $1,800/month. The ceiling moves with you — there's no cap on what a real closer can earn here.


What You'll Do


Sales (core of the role):

  • Handle inbound leads
  • Run outbound outreach (calls, follow-ups, cold calling)
  • Qualify and close high-ticket services ($1K–$5K+)
  • Own and manage the pipeline


Daily Operations:

  • Dispatch service providers and coordinate jobs
  • Collect payment from customers
  • Follow up post-service to make sure customers are satisfied
  • Handle admin tied to the owner's day-to-day


Hiring (when needed):

  • Run end-to-end hiring — sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding new team members


Requirements

  • Based in Brazil, working remotely
  • Proven sales background with results you can speak to (mandatory)
  • Strong English — C1 or higher
  • Excellent, reliable internet (non-negotiable)
  • Comfortable working across U.S. time zones
  • Able to run full-cycle sales, not just closing


One Thing to Be Clear About

This is a performance role for people who want to win. You'll be the owner's right hand — sales is the core of the job, but you'll also be the person they trust to keep operations running and the team growing. If you don't have real sales experience and real results, this isn't the seat for you. If you do — this is the kind of role that changes your trajectory.

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Java Software Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position: Java Engineer- AI Driven Automation & Vulnerability Remediation

Location: Remote in Brazil

Employment Type: CLT

Monthly Salary in BRL: 18,000-21,554.40 reais


About the Role

We are partnering with a leading enterprise banking client to build a next-generation engineering capability focused on AI-driven vulnerability detection and automated remediation at scale.

This team is tackling a critical challenge: modernizing application security by leveraging LLMs and AI agents to scan, identify, and remediate vulnerabilities across large-scale code repositories.


As a Senior Java Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and building intelligent automation pipelines that integrate LLMs, AI agents, and enterprise DevOps workflows to significantly improve security posture and development velocity.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design and build automation pipelines that scan source code repositories and identify security vulnerabilities using LLMs and AI tooling
  • Develop intelligent remediation workflows to automatically resolve or recommend fixes for vulnerabilities
  • Integrate AI-driven systems into existing DevOps pipelines (GitLab, CI/CD)
  • Collaborate with architecture teams to build scalable, enterprise-grade solutions across large codebases
  • Work hands-on with Java/Spring Boot applications to implement secure coding and remediation patterns
  • Build and optimize AI agent workflows including rules, skills, and orchestration logic
  • Ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and performant in a high-volume enterprise environment
  • Partner with platform and security teams to continuously improve code quality, resiliency, and compliance


What We’re Looking For

Core Requirements

  • Strong/Fluent in English
  • 5+ years of experience in Java development
  • Strong hands-on experience with Spring Boot / enterprise Java applications
  • Deep understanding of:
  • Multithreading & concurrency
  • Design patterns & clean code principles
  • Scalable system architecture
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab preferred)
  • Familiarity with large-scale codebases and repository management


AI / Modern Exposure (Highly Preferred)

  • Exposure to or experience with:
  • LLMs (e.g., Claude, GPT, or similar)
  • AI-assisted development workflows
  • AI agents, pipelines, or orchestration frameworks
  • Understanding of how AI can be leveraged to solve real engineering problems, not just theoretical exposure


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in application security, vulnerability scanning, or remediation
  • Knowledge of DevSecOps practices
  • Exposure to tools like Windsurf or other AI developer platforms
  • Experience in enterprise banking or financial services environments

title: Médico Endocrinologista (RQE)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Endocrinologista (RQE) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.

title: Sr AI Engineer - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr AI Engineer - Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Senior AI Engineer


PITZ | Remote | Reports to CTO

A trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it.

PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop.

We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it.

Why this role exists

We're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound.

If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you.

This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them.

Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product.

What you'll build

The voice-to-action pipeline.  Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab.

The recommendation engine.  Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue.

The credit scoring models.  Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals.

The data flywheel.  Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence.

US market integrations.  Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, PartsTech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics.

What you bring

3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production.  Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways.

NLP or voice experience.  You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments.

Full-stack ML instincts.  You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team.

Builder mentality.  You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter.

Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred.  You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries.


Requirements


Timezone:  Must be available during US/LatAm business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async.

Commitment:  This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%.

Travel:  Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that.


What makes this different

At most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day.

You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality.

And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

title: Analista Administrativo de Mídia
description:

Buscamos um profissional detalhista e organizado para suportar a operação financeira e administrativa do nosso time de mídia. Você será responsável por garantir que o fluxo entre a contratação dos espaços publicitários, a veiculação e o faturamento ocorra sem erros, atuando como o elo entre o planejamento de mídia, os veículos e o departamento financeiro.


Principais atribuições


  • Emissão de PIs (Pedidos de Inserção) e inclusão de POs no sistema.
  • Geração de PDFs e envio de provisões e reprovisões financeiras.
  • Ajustes de PIs durante o período de veiculação em alinhamento com o time de Mídia.
  • Conciliação final de PIs com Notas Fiscais e comprovantes de veiculação (checking).
  • Controle e monitoramento de POs existentes.
  • Interface com o time de Mídia para solicitação e atualização de novas POs.


Requisitos


  • Domínio do Excel para controle de verbas, fórmulas e conciliações.
  • Conhecimento em rotinas de faturamento e Notas Fiscais.
  • Facilidade no aprendizado e uso de sistemas administrativos/ERP.
  • Perfil organizado, com foco em prazos e precisão de dados.


Diferenciais


  • Experiência prévia com o Sistema AD Media.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de veículos digitais e ferramentas de compra de mídia.
  • Vivência anterior em agências de publicidade ou veículos de comunicação.



O que você vai encontrar por aqui:

  • Plano de saúde e Odontológico Sulamérica extensivo a dependentes
  • Seguro de vida
  • VR ou VA
  • Auxílio home office
  • Auxílio Creche (para filhos até 5 anos e 11 meses);
  • Plataforma de Aprendizagem eLearning (Dentsu university)
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento de Carreira
  • Parceria para desenvolvimento de idiomas, especialização, pós-graduação e MBA
  • Programas de desenvolvimento local e Global
  • Day Off de Aniversário;

Sobre a dentsu internacional

Parte da dentsu, dentsu internacional com sede em Londres, opera em mais de 145 mercados no mundo inteiro com mais de 48.000 colaboradores. Ajudamos nossos clientes a conquistar, manter e fazer crescer seus consumidores e alcançar um progresso significativo para os seus negócios. Com os melhores serviços e soluções em mídia, CXM, e criatividade.


Trabalhando conosco

Juntando-se à dentsu international, você se juntará a um grupo de 48.000 pessoas. Será uma oportunidade de produzir trabalho orientado para a construção da sua carreira. Ao longo do caminho, você se unirá a colegas inspiradores e encontrará uma riqueza de clientes, culturas e experiências. Oferecemos desafios motivadores, experiências memoráveis e oportunidades para moldar seu futuro.


Inclusão e Diversidade

Estamos orgulhosos de ser diferente e isso começa com nossa gente. Acreditamos na igualdade de oportunidades para todos e não definimos as pessoas por sua raça, sexo, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência. A individualidade é o que nos torna grandes, queremos que cada um traga seu eu completo para o trabalho e crie algo surpreendente. É com isso que nos preocupamos. Portanto, quer você se junte a nós, quer procure mudar para uma parte diferente do negócio, nós trabalhamos duro para garantir a criação de oportunidades iguais para todos.


Nossas 8 maneiras

Com mais de 48.000 especialistas dedicados em 145 mercados, nossas '8 maneiras' formam e guiam a maneira como fazemos as coisas aqui, de modo que, juntos, podemos alcançar o 'nunca antes' para nossos clientes, para a sociedade e uns para os outros.


Nós sonhamos alto.

Inspiramos mudanças.

Formamos equipes sem limites.

Todos nós lideramos.

Tornamos isso realidade.

Escalamos alto.

Escolhemos a emoção.

Somos uma força para o bem.

Somos dentsu


Mantenha-se conectado


Visite nosso website para saber mais e se conectar conosco nas mídias sociais.

Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, high-performance full stack applications with a strong emphasis on backend architecture.
  • Lead and contribute to the integration of AI/ML features into products, collaborating closely with data scientists and engineers.
  • Develop robust backend services and APIs using Python or Node.js (Express, NestJS) .

  • Identify, prioritize, and execute tasks throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Ensure code quality through testing, code reviews, and best engineering practices.
  • Document development phases, monitor system performance, and improve reliability.
  • Participate in Scrum meetings and contribute to product and technical decision-making.


Qualifications

  • Higher education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a focus on Artificial Intelligence and/or Machine Learning
  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with strong backend expertise in Python and/or Node.js.
  • Proficiency with frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments.
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as MySQL, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL.
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, Agile development principles, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Interest in applied AI and automation-driven development.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bookkeeper em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition

Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.

At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.

We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ, this is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.

What You'll Do

  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting 
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Asana and Everhour or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. 
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.

The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.

﻿

Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.
